name: Spectral band gain and progress-weighted trust
plain: Band masks are built correctly from fftfreq. One function boosts mid and attenuates highest frequencies. Another reweights denoised output by progress, trusting highs less early. The "quantum" in the pack name is branding; this part is FFT gains with a golden-ratio exponent.
math:
mask: L=σ(20(lc−d)), H=σ(20(d−hc)), M=clamp(1−L−H,0)
enhance: gain=L+M(1+detail)+H(1−denoise)
guided: progress=1−σ/σmax; W=L+M(.4+.6p)+H·max(.1,p^0.618); F*=(1−w+wW)
no DC exemption, and no variance restore
